title: SCoRD: Semantic-Assisted Continual Retriever-Reranker Distillation for LLM-Based Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommendation systems increasingly adopt a two-stage pipeline, where an ID-based retriever retrieves candidates and an LLM-based reranker refines their rankings. To improve retrieval quality, reranker-to-retriever distillation is commonly used to transfer the reranker's knowledge to the retriever. For practical deployment, however, this pipeline must continually adapt to evolving interests and incoming interactions. A naive solution is to repeatedly update the LLM reranker and distill its latest knowledge, but this incurs prohibitive costs. Updating the retriever alone is cheaper, but its limited capacity makes adaptation from sparse data difficult. We propose SCoRD, a continual knowledge distillation framework for LLM-based reranking pipelines under a non-stationary data stream. tldr: SCoRD提出了一种语义辅助的持续蒸馏框架，通过将LLM重排序器的意图推理能力蒸馏为可复用的意图级指导，在非平稳数据流下高效提升检索器性能，避免了反复更新LLM的高昂成本。
en_tdlr: SCoRD proposes a semantic-assisted continual distillation framework that distills LLM reranker's intent-inference capability into reusable intent-level guidance, efficiently improving retriever performance under non-stationary data streams while avoiding the prohibitive cost of repeatedly updating the LLM.
